# Make Tech Easier

> > Practical tech tutorials and insights covering Windows, Android, privacy tools, and productivity software with a focus on helping everyday users navigate modern technology.

Make Tech Easier provides how-to guides, reviews, and analysis for popular platforms including Windows 11, Android, Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, and emerging AI tools. The site emphasizes privacy protection, productivity optimization, and helping readers make informed decisions about consumer technology.

## Key Topics

- Windows 11 customization and optimization
- Android privacy and productivity
- Social media privacy (Instagram, TikTok, X, WhatsApp, Facebook)
- Privacy concerns and detection methods
- AI coding assistants (Cursor AI, ChatGPT)
- Smart glasses and wearable tech privacy
- Consumer scam awareness (Amazon PC deals, storage misleading advertising)
- Browser productivity tools (Vivaldi Workspaces)
- Linux desktop environments (i3 window manager)
- Minimalist Android launchers
- File conversion and management tools
- Anonymous social media browsing
- Terminal text editors
- Cybersecurity best practices
- Smart home privacy (Samsung appliances)

## Windows Tutorials and Customization

- [The Easiest Ways to View Android Notifications in Windows](https://www.maketecheasier.com/android-notifications-in-windows-10): Tutorial for syncing Android notifications to Windows via Phone Link
- [I Tamed Windows Start Menu By Removing "All" and "Recommended" Sections](https://www.maketecheasier.com/remove-windows-start-menu-all-recommended-sections): Registry guide for removing Windows 11 Start Menu clutter sections
- [The Amazon PC Trap: Why Those "Cheap" Deals Are Actually Scams](https://www.maketecheasier.com/amazon-new-windows-pc-storage-scam): Exposes Amazon Windows PC deals with misleading OneDrive storage claims
